using BlobGame.Player.StateMachine;
using UnityEngine;

namespace BlobGame.Player
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Translates the gameplay state machine into presentation-only animation.
    /// Gameplay remains authoritative: one-shot clips may finish or be interrupted
    /// without delaying movement, jumping, landing, or state transitions.
    /// </summary>
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    [RequireComponent(typeof(Animator), typeof(SpriteRenderer))]
    public sealed class BlobAnimationController : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private const string Idle = "Idle";
        private const string Move = "Move";
        private const string JumpPrepare = "JumpPrepare";
        private const string JumpRise = "JumpRise";
        private const string JumpApex = "JumpApex";
        private const string Fall = "Fall";
        private const string Land = "Land";
        private const string SprintBurst = "SprintBurst";
        private const string TransformOut = "TransformOut";
        private const string TransformIn = "TransformIn";

        [Header("References")]
        [SerializeField] private Animator animator;
        [SerializeField] private SpriteRenderer spriteRenderer;

        [Header("Playback")]
        [SerializeField] private BlobAnimationConfig config;
        [Tooltip("Playback multiplier used by the normal Move clip during sustained sprint.")]
        [SerializeField, Min(1f)] private float sustainedSprintAnimationSpeed = 1.65f;

        private BlobController blob;
        private BlobState previousGameplayState;
        private int currentVisualStateHash;
        private VisualSequence sequence;
        private BlobMovementConfig transformationTarget;
        private TransformationPhase transformationPhase;

        public bool IsTransforming => transformationPhase != TransformationPhase.None;
        public bool IsTransformationComplete => transformationPhase == TransformationPhase.Complete;

        private enum VisualSequence
        {
            None,
            JumpPrepare,
            JumpApex,
            Land
        }

        private enum TransformationPhase
        {
            None,
            Out,
            In,
            Complete
        }

        private void Reset()
        {
            animator = GetComponent<Animator>();
            spriteRenderer = GetComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
        }

        private void OnValidate()
        {
            if (animator == null)
                animator = GetComponent<Animator>();

            if (spriteRenderer == null)
                spriteRenderer = GetComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
        }

        public void Initialize(BlobController owner)
        {
            blob = owner;
            OnValidate();
            previousGameplayState = null;
            sequence = VisualSequence.None;
            transformationPhase = TransformationPhase.None;
            ApplyAnimationProfile(blob.CurrentMovementConfig?.AnimationProfile);
            TickVisuals();
        }

        public void BeginTransformation(BlobMovementConfig target)
        {
            if (target == null || IsTransforming)
                return;

            transformationTarget = target;
            transformationPhase = TransformationPhase.Out;
            sequence = VisualSequence.None;
            Play(TransformOut);
        }

        public void FinishTransformation()
        {
            transformationTarget = null;
            transformationPhase = TransformationPhase.None;
            previousGameplayState = null;
            sequence = VisualSequence.None;
            animator.speed = 1f;
        }

        public void TickVisuals()
        {
            if (blob == null || animator == null || spriteRenderer == null || blob.CurrentState == null)
                return;

            spriteRenderer.flipX = blob.FacingDirection < 0f;

            if (IsTransforming)
            {
                UpdateTransformation();
                return;
            }

            BlobState gameplayState = blob.CurrentState;
            if (gameplayState != previousGameplayState)
                EnterGameplayState(previousGameplayState, gameplayState);
            else
                UpdateCurrentVisual(gameplayState);

            previousGameplayState = gameplayState;
        }

        private void UpdateTransformation()
        {
            if (transformationPhase == TransformationPhase.Out && HasCurrentClipFinished())
            {
                blob.ApplyPendingMovementConfig();
                ApplyAnimationProfile(transformationTarget?.AnimationProfile);
                Play(TransformIn);
                transformationPhase = TransformationPhase.In;
                return;
            }

            if (transformationPhase == TransformationPhase.In && HasCurrentClipFinished())
                transformationPhase = TransformationPhase.Complete;
        }

        private void ApplyAnimationProfile(BlobAnimationProfile profile)
        {
            if (profile != null && profile.AnimatorController != null)
                animator.runtimeAnimatorController = profile.AnimatorController;
        }

        private void EnterGameplayState(BlobState previousState, BlobState currentState)
        {
            if (currentState == blob.JumpState)
            {
                Play(JumpPrepare);
                sequence = VisualSequence.JumpPrepare;
                return;
            }

            if (currentState == blob.FallState)
            {
                if (previousState == blob.JumpState)
                {
                    Play(JumpApex);
                    sequence = VisualSequence.JumpApex;
                }
                else
                {
                    Play(Fall);
                    sequence = VisualSequence.None;
                }

                return;
            }

            if (previousState == blob.FallState)
            {
                Play(Land);
                sequence = VisualSequence.Land;
                return;
            }

            sequence = VisualSequence.None;
            PlayGroundedState(currentState);
        }

        private void UpdateCurrentVisual(BlobState gameplayState)
        {
            if (sequence == VisualSequence.JumpPrepare)
            {
                if (gameplayState != blob.JumpState)
                    return;

                if (HasCurrentClipFinished())
                {
                    Play(JumpRise);
                    sequence = VisualSequence.None;
                }

                return;
            }

            if (sequence == VisualSequence.JumpApex)
            {
                if (gameplayState != blob.FallState)
                    return;

                if (HasCurrentClipFinished())
                {
                    Play(Fall);
                    sequence = VisualSequence.None;
                }

                return;
            }

            if (sequence == VisualSequence.Land)
            {
                // Movement and sprint are allowed to interrupt the landing squash.
                if (gameplayState != blob.IdleState || HasCurrentClipFinished())
                {
                    sequence = VisualSequence.None;
                    PlayGroundedState(gameplayState);
                }

                return;
            }

            if (gameplayState == blob.SprintState)
            {
                int desiredHash = blob.SprintState.IsBurstPhase
                    ? Animator.StringToHash(SprintBurst)
                    : Animator.StringToHash(Move);

                if (desiredHash != currentVisualStateHash)
                    PlayGroundedState(gameplayState);
            }
        }

        private void PlayGroundedState(BlobState gameplayState)
        {
            if (gameplayState == blob.IdleState)
            {
                Play(Idle);
                return;
            }

            if (gameplayState == blob.MoveState)
            {
                Play(Move);
                return;
            }

            if (gameplayState == blob.SprintState)
            {
                if (blob.SprintState.IsBurstPhase)
                    Play(SprintBurst);
                else
                    Play(Move, config != null ? config.SustainedSprintAnimationSpeed : sustainedSprintAnimationSpeed);
            }
        }

        private void Play(string stateName, float playbackSpeed = 1f)
        {
            int stateHash = Animator.StringToHash(stateName);
            animator.speed = playbackSpeed;
            animator.Play(stateHash, 0, 0f);
            currentVisualStateHash = stateHash;
        }

        private bool HasCurrentClipFinished()
        {
            AnimatorStateInfo stateInfo = animator.GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0);
            return stateInfo.shortNameHash == currentVisualStateHash && stateInfo.normalizedTime >= 1f;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/Player/Sensors/BlobSensors.cs
================================================
using UnityEngine;

namespace BlobGame.Player
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Samples the environment around the player and exposes locomotion facts,
    /// such as whether the player is currently grounded.
    /// </summary>
    [RequireComponent(typeof(Collider2D))]
    public sealed class BlobSensors : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private BlobSensorConfig config;
        [Tooltip("Thickness of the overlap box placed below the player.")]
        [SerializeField, Min(0.01f)] private float groundCheckDepth = 0.12f;
        [Tooltip("Ground-check width as a fraction of the player collider width.")]
        [SerializeField, Range(0.1f, 1f)] private float groundCheckWidth = 0.75f;
        [Tooltip("Physics layers that are allowed to count as ground.")]
        [SerializeField] private LayerMask groundMask = ~0;

        private readonly Collider2D[] groundHits = new Collider2D[8];
        private readonly Collider2D[] overlapHits = new Collider2D[16];
        private Collider2D bodyCollider;
        private ContactFilter2D groundFilter;
        private float GroundCheckDepth => config != null ? config.GroundCheckDepth : groundCheckDepth;
        private float GroundCheckWidth => config != null ? config.GroundCheckWidth : groundCheckWidth;

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether a valid non-trigger ground collider was detected below the player.
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsGrounded { get; private set; }
        public bool IsOverlappingGround { get; private set; }

        private void Awake()
        {
            bodyCollider = GetComponent<Collider2D>();
            groundFilter = new ContactFilter2D
            {
                useLayerMask = true,
                layerMask = config != null ? config.GroundMask : groundMask,
                useTriggers = false
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Refreshes the cached environment results used by the locomotion state machine.
        /// </summary>
        public void Refresh()
        {
            if (bodyCollider == null)
            {
                IsGrounded = false;
                IsOverlappingGround = false;
                return;
            }

            IsOverlappingGround = false;
            int overlapCount = bodyCollider.Overlap(groundFilter, overlapHits);
            for (int i = 0; i < overlapCount; i++)
            {
                Collider2D hit = overlapHits[i];
                if (hit == null || hit == bodyCollider || hit.transform.root == transform.root)
                    continue;

                ColliderDistance2D separation = bodyCollider.Distance(hit);
                if (separation.isOverlapped && separation.distance < -0.1f)
                {
                    IsOverlappingGround = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            Bounds bounds = bodyCollider.bounds;

            // Place a thin overlap box slightly below the collider's lower bound.
            Vector2 checkSize = new(bounds.size.x * GroundCheckWidth, GroundCheckDepth);
            Vector2 checkCenter = new(bounds.center.x, bounds.min.y - GroundCheckDepth * 0.45f);
            int hitCount = Physics2D.OverlapBox(checkCenter, checkSize, 0f, groundFilter, groundHits);

            IsGrounded = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < hitCount; i++)
            {
                Collider2D hit = groundHits[i];

                // Ignore the body collider and colliders under the same root so the
                // player's own child hitboxes cannot be detected as ground.
                if (hit != null && hit != bodyCollider && hit.transform.root != transform.root)
                {
                    IsGrounded = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// draw the checkbox
        /// </summary>
        private void OnDrawGizmosSelected()
        {
            Collider2D target = bodyCollider != null ? bodyCollider : GetComponent<Collider2D>();
            if (target == null)
                return;

            Bounds bounds = target.bounds;
            Vector3 center = new(bounds.center.x, bounds.min.y - GroundCheckDepth * 0.45f, 0f);
            Vector3 size = new(bounds.size.x * GroundCheckWidth, GroundCheckDepth, 0.01f);
            Gizmos.color = IsGrounded ? Color.green : Color.red;
            Gizmos.DrawWireCube(center, size);
        }
    }
}



================================================
FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/PowerUps/Grass/Grapple2D.cs
================================================
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;

namespace BlobGame.Player
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Mouse-aimed grapple unlocked by the grapple power-up. Holding the left
    /// mouse button attaches; releasing it lets the player's current momentum go.
    /// </summary>
    [RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody2D), typeof(BlobInputReader))]
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public sealed class Grapple2D : MonoBehaviour, BlobGame.Player.PowerUps.IConfigurablePowerUpAbility
    {
        [Header("Targeting")]
        [SerializeField] private GrappleConfig config;
        [SerializeField] private Camera targetCamera;
        [SerializeField, Min(0.1f)] private float maxDistance = 12f;
        [SerializeField] private LayerMask grappleMask = ~0;

        [Header("Visual")]
        [SerializeField] private LineRenderer rope;
        [SerializeField] private Color aimMarkerColor = Color.cyan;
        [SerializeField] private Material lineMaterial = null;

        private Rigidbody2D body;
        private Collider2D bodyCollider;
        private BlobInputReader input;
        private BlobController player;
        private DistanceJoint2D ropeJoint;
        private Material generatedRopeMaterial;
        private readonly RaycastHit2D[] collisionHits = new RaycastHit2D[8];
        private ContactFilter2D collisionFilter;
        private CollisionDetectionMode2D collisionModeBeforeGrapple;
        private Vector2 grapplePoint;
        private bool isUnlocked;
        private bool hasAimTarget;
        private bool waitForGrappleRelease;

        public bool IsAttached => ropeJoint != null && ropeJoint.enabled;
        public bool IsUnlocked => isUnlocked;

        private GrappleConfig ActiveConfig => player != null
            ? player.CurrentMovementConfig?.GrappleAbilityConfig ?? config
            : config;
        private float MaxDistance => ActiveConfig != null ? ActiveConfig.MaxDistance : maxDistance;
        private LayerMask GrappleMask => ActiveConfig != null ? ActiveConfig.GrappleMask : grappleMask;
        private float SwingAcceleration => ActiveConfig != null ? ActiveConfig.SwingAcceleration : 14f;
        private float ClimbSpeed => ActiveConfig != null ? ActiveConfig.ClimbSpeed : 4f;
        private Texture2D AimMarkerTexture => ActiveConfig != null ? ActiveConfig.AimMarkerTexture : null;
        private float AimMarkerSize => ActiveConfig != null ? ActiveConfig.AimMarkerSize : 24f;
        private Material ActiveRopeMaterial => ActiveConfig != null ? ActiveConfig.GrappleMaterial : lineMaterial;

        private void Awake()
        {
            body = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
            bodyCollider = GetComponent<Collider2D>();
            input = GetComponent<BlobInputReader>();
            player = GetComponent<BlobController>();
            if (targetCamera == null)
                targetCamera = Camera.main;

            ropeJoint = GetComponent<DistanceJoint2D>();
            if (ropeJoint == null)
                ropeJoint = gameObject.AddComponent<DistanceJoint2D>();

            ropeJoint.enabled = false;
            ropeJoint.autoConfigureDistance = false;
            ropeJoint.autoConfigureConnectedAnchor = false;
            ropeJoint.maxDistanceOnly = true;
            collisionFilter = new ContactFilter2D
            {
                useLayerMask = true,
                layerMask = ~0,
                useTriggers = false
            };
            EnsureRopeRenderer();
            SetRopeVisible(false);
        }

        public void Activate(ScriptableObject abilityConfig)
        {
            if (abilityConfig != null && !(abilityConfig is GrappleConfig))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("Grapple2D requires a GrappleConfig ability config.", this);
                return;
            }

            if (abilityConfig is GrappleConfig grappleConfig)
                config = grappleConfig;

            ApplyRopeMaterial();
            isUnlocked = true;
            enabled = true;
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (Time.timeScale == 0f)
                return;

            if (!isUnlocked || player == null || !player.CurrentProfileHasGrappleAbility)
            {
                if (IsAttached)
                    Release();
                hasAimTarget = false;
                return;
            }

            // Jumping releases the rope before the normal jump state is entered.
            // No horizontal velocity is changed, so swing momentum carries on.
            if (IsAttached)
            {
                if (input.JumpPressed)
                {
                    waitForGrappleRelease = true;
                    Release();
                    player?.JumpFromGrapple();
                    return;
                }

                if (!input.GrappleHeld)
                {
                    Release();
                    return;
                }

                UpdateRope();
                return;
            }

            if (waitForGrappleRelease)
            {
                if (!input.GrappleHeld)
                    waitForGrappleRelease = false;

                hasAimTarget = false;
                return;
            }

            hasAimTarget = TryGetAimTarget(out grapplePoint);
            if (input.GrappleHeld && hasAimTarget)
                Attach(grapplePoint);
        }

        private void FixedUpdate()
        {
            if (!isUnlocked || !IsAttached)
                return;

            // Horizontal force changes the pendulum arc while the distance joint
            // keeps the player attached to the same anchor.
            Vector2 acceleration = Vector2.right * (input.MoveX * SwingAcceleration);
            float climbInput = input.MoveY;
            if (Mathf.Abs(climbInput) > Mathf.Epsilon)
            {
                float newDistance = Mathf.Clamp(
                    ropeJoint.distance - climbInput * ClimbSpeed * Time.fixedDeltaTime,
                    0.5f,
                    MaxDistance);
                float shorteningDistance = ropeJoint.distance - newDistance;
                Vector2 directionToAnchor = (grapplePoint - body.worldCenterOfMass).normalized;
                if (shorteningDistance <= 0f
                    || !IsMovementBlocked(directionToAnchor, shorteningDistance))
                {
                    ropeJoint.distance = newDistance;
                }
            }

            Vector2 predictedVelocity = body.linearVelocity + acceleration * Time.fixedDeltaTime;
            predictedVelocity += Physics2D.gravity * (body.gravityScale * Time.fixedDeltaTime);
            if (TryBlockSwingThroughObstacle(predictedVelocity))
                return;

            body.AddForce(acceleration, ForceMode2D.Force);
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            Release();
            hasAimTarget = false;
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (generatedRopeMaterial != null)
                Destroy(generatedRopeMaterial);
        }

        private void EnsureRopeRenderer()
        {
            if (rope != null)
            {
                ApplyRopeMaterial();
                return;
            }

            GameObject ropeObject = new GameObject("Grapple Line");
            ropeObject.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
            rope = ropeObject.AddComponent<LineRenderer>();
            rope.useWorldSpace = true;
            rope.positionCount = 2;
            rope.startWidth = config != null ? config.grappleWidth : 0.4f;
            rope.endWidth = config != null ? config.grappleWidth :  0.4f;
            rope.alignment = LineAlignment.TransformZ;
            rope.numCapVertices = 3;
            rope.textureMode = LineTextureMode.Tile;
            rope.startColor = Color.white;
            rope.endColor = Color.white;
            Shader shader = Shader.Find("Sprites/Default");
            if (shader != null)
            {
                generatedRopeMaterial = new Material(shader);
            }
            ApplyRopeMaterial();
        }

        private void ApplyRopeMaterial()
        {
            if (rope == null)
                return;

            Material materialToUse = ActiveRopeMaterial != null ? ActiveRopeMaterial : generatedRopeMaterial;
            if (materialToUse != null)
                rope.material = materialToUse;
        }

        private bool TryGetAimTarget(out Vector2 target)
        {
            target = default;
            if (targetCamera == null || Mouse.current == null)
                return false;

            Vector2 mouseScreen = Mouse.current.position.ReadValue();
            float cameraDepth = Mathf.Abs(targetCamera.transform.position.z - transform.position.z);
            Vector3 mouseWorld = targetCamera.ScreenToWorldPoint(
                new Vector3(mouseScreen.x, mouseScreen.y, cameraDepth));

            Vector2 origin = body.worldCenterOfMass;
            Vector2 aim = (Vector2)mouseWorld - origin;
            float aimDistance = aim.magnitude;
            if (aimDistance <= Mathf.Epsilon || aimDistance > MaxDistance)
                return false;

            RaycastHit2D[] hits = Physics2D.RaycastAll(origin, aim.normalized, aimDistance, GrappleMask);
            foreach (RaycastHit2D hit in hits)
            {
                if (hit.collider == null || hit.transform.root == transform.root)
                    continue;

                target = hit.point;
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        private void Attach(Vector2 point)
        {
            player?.RestoreDashAvailability();
            collisionModeBeforeGrapple = body.collisionDetectionMode;
            body.collisionDetectionMode = CollisionDetectionMode2D.Continuous;
            grapplePoint = point;
            ropeJoint.connectedBody = null;
            ropeJoint.anchor = transform.InverseTransformPoint(body.worldCenterOfMass);
            ropeJoint.connectedAnchor = grapplePoint;
            ropeJoint.distance = Vector2.Distance(body.worldCenterOfMass, grapplePoint);
            ropeJoint.maxDistanceOnly = true;
            ropeJoint.enabled = true;
            SetRopeVisible(true);
            UpdateRope();
        }

        public void Release()
        {
            bool wasAttached = IsAttached;
            if (ropeJoint != null)
                ropeJoint.enabled = false;

            if (wasAttached && body != null)
                body.collisionDetectionMode = collisionModeBeforeGrapple;

            SetRopeVisible(false);
            if (wasAttached)
                player?.PreserveMomentumAfterGrapple();
        }

        public void ReleaseForDash()
        {
            waitForGrappleRelease = true;
            Release();
        }

        private bool TryBlockSwingThroughObstacle(Vector2 velocity)
        {
            if (bodyCollider == null || velocity.sqrMagnitude <= Mathf.Epsilon)
                return false;

            float distance = velocity.magnitude * Time.fixedDeltaTime;
            int hitCount = bodyCollider.Cast(velocity.normalized, collisionFilter, collisionHits, distance);
            RaycastHit2D closestHit = default;
            float closestDistance = float.PositiveInfinity;

            for (int i = 0; i < hitCount; i++)
            {
                RaycastHit2D hit = collisionHits[i];
                if (hit.collider == null || hit.transform.root == transform.root || hit.normal.sqrMagnitude <= Mathf.Epsilon)
                    continue;

                if (Vector2.Dot(velocity, hit.normal) >= 0f)
                    continue;

                if (hit.distance < closestDistance)
                {
                    closestHit = hit;
                    closestDistance = hit.distance;
                }
            }

            if (closestDistance == float.PositiveInfinity)
                return false;

            float velocityIntoSurface = Vector2.Dot(velocity, closestHit.normal);
            body.linearVelocity = velocity - velocityIntoSurface * closestHit.normal;
            return true;
        }

        private bool IsMovementBlocked(Vector2 direction, float distance)
        {
            if (bodyCollider == null || distance <= Mathf.Epsilon)
                return false;

            int hitCount = bodyCollider.Cast(direction, collisionFilter, collisionHits, distance);
            for (int i = 0; i < hitCount; i++)
            {
                RaycastHit2D hit = collisionHits[i];
                if (hit.collider != null && hit.transform.root != transform.root)
                    return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        private void UpdateRope()
        {
            if (rope == null)
                return;

            rope.positionCount = 2;
            rope.SetPosition(0, body.worldCenterOfMass);
            rope.SetPosition(1, grapplePoint);
        }

        private void SetRopeVisible(bool visible)
        {
            if (rope != null)
                rope.enabled = visible;
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            if (!isUnlocked || IsAttached || !hasAimTarget || targetCamera == null || !IsMouseInRange())
                return;

            Vector3 screenPoint = targetCamera.WorldToScreenPoint(grapplePoint);
            if (screenPoint.z <= 0f)
                return;

            // Draw a small target reticle at the valid grapple point without
            // requiring a separate scene object or sprite assignment.
            const float armLength = 5f;
            const float gap = 3f;
            const float thickness = 2f;
            float x = screenPoint.x;
            float y = Screen.height - screenPoint.y;
            Color previousColor = GUI.color;
            GUI.color = aimMarkerColor;
            if (AimMarkerTexture != null)
            {
                float size = AimMarkerSize;
                GUI.color = Color.white;
                GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(x - size * 0.5f, y - size * 0.5f, size, size), AimMarkerTexture, ScaleMode.ScaleToFit, true);
                GUI.color = previousColor;
                return;
            }

            GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(x - gap - armLength, y - thickness * 0.5f, armLength, thickness), Texture2D.whiteTexture);
            GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(x + gap, y - thickness * 0.5f, armLength, thickness), Texture2D.whiteTexture);
            GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(x - thickness * 0.5f, y - gap - armLength, thickness, armLength), Texture2D.whiteTexture);
            GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(x - thickness * 0.5f, y + gap, thickness, armLength), Texture2D.whiteTexture);
            GUI.color = previousColor;
        }

        private bool IsMouseInRange()
        {
            if (targetCamera == null || Mouse.current == null || body == null)
                return false;

            Vector2 mouseScreen = Mouse.current.position.ReadValue();
            float cameraDepth = Mathf.Abs(targetCamera.transform.position.z - transform.position.z);
            Vector3 mouseWorld = targetCamera.ScreenToWorldPoint(
                new Vector3(mouseScreen.x, mouseScreen.y, cameraDepth));
            return ((Vector2)mouseWorld - body.worldCenterOfMass).sqrMagnitude <= MaxDistance * MaxDistance;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/PowerUps/Modularity/BlobPowerUpManager.cs
================================================
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace BlobGame.Player.PowerUps
{
    /// <summary>Owns upgrades collected by one player during the current run.</summary>
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public sealed class BlobPowerUpManager : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private readonly HashSet<string> collectedIds = new();
        private BlobController player;

        private void Awake()
        {
            player = GetComponent<BlobController>();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Applies a definition once. Returns false when the definition is
        /// missing or has no stable ID; duplicate pickups are harmless.
        /// </summary>
        public bool Collect(BlobPowerUpDefinition definition)
        {
            if (definition == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(definition.Id))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("Cannot collect a power-up with no definition or ID.", this);
                return false;
            }

            if (!collectedIds.Add(definition.Id))
                return true;

            foreach (BlobPowerUpEffect effect in definition.Effects)
            {
                if (effect != null)
                    effect.Apply(player);
            }

            return true;
        }

        public bool HasCollected(string id)
        {
            return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id) && collectedIds.Contains(id);
        }
    }
}

using BlobGame.Player;
using BlobGame.Player.PowerUps;
using UnityEngine;

[CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "NewAbilityConfig", menuName = "Abilities/New Ability")]
public class NewAbilityConfig : BlobPowerUpEffect
{
    [SerializeField] private ScriptableObject abilityConfig;
    [Tooltip("Assign a component from a prefab that implements IConfigurablePowerUpAbility.")]
    [SerializeField] private MonoBehaviour abilityScript;

    public ScriptableObject AbilityConfig => abilityConfig;
    public MonoBehaviour AbilityScript => abilityScript;

    public override void Apply(BlobController player)
    {
        if (player == null)
            return;

        if (abilityScript == null || !(abilityScript is IConfigurablePowerUpAbility))
        {
            Debug.LogWarning($"Cannot apply {name}: assign an ability script that implements IConfigurablePowerUpAbility.", this);
            return;
        }

        System.Type abilityType = abilityScript.GetType();
        MonoBehaviour ability = player.GetComponent(abilityType) as MonoBehaviour;
        if (ability == null)
            ability = player.gameObject.AddComponent(abilityType) as MonoBehaviour;

        if (ability is IConfigurablePowerUpAbility configurableAbility)
            configurableAbility.Activate(abilityConfig);
    }
}

================================================
FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/PowerUps/Stone/RockAbility.cs
================================================
using BlobGame.Player;
using BlobGame.Player.PowerUps;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
using UnityEngine.Tilemaps;

[RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody2D), typeof(BlobInputReader))]
[DisallowMultipleComponent]
public sealed class RockAbility : MonoBehaviour, IConfigurablePowerUpAbility
{
    private const string BreakableTag = "breakable";

    private enum SlamPhase
    {
        Inactive,
        Hopping,
        Slamming
    }

    private BlobInputReader input;
    private BlobController player;
    private Rigidbody2D body;
    private Collider2D bodyCollider;
    private RockAbilityConfig config;
    private ContactFilter2D collisionFilter;
    private readonly RaycastHit2D[] groundHits = new RaycastHit2D[8];
    private SlamPhase phase;
    private float hopStartY;
    private bool isActive;
    private bool IsRockMovementActive =>
        player != null
        && player.CurrentMovementConfig != null
        && player.CurrentMovementConfig.AbilityDefinition != null
        && player.CurrentMovementConfig.AbilityDefinition.AbilityConfig == config;
    private float HopHeight => config != null ? config.HopHeight : 1f;
    private float SlamSpeed => config != null ? config.SlamSpeed : 20f;
    private float GroundProbeDistance => config != null ? config.GroundProbeDistance : 0.12f;

    private void Awake()
    {
        input = GetComponent<BlobInputReader>();
        player = GetComponent<BlobController>();
        body = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
        bodyCollider = GetComponent<Collider2D>();
        collisionFilter = new ContactFilter2D
        {
            useTriggers = false
        };
    }

    public void Activate(ScriptableObject abilityConfig)
    {
        if (abilityConfig != null && !(abilityConfig is RockAbilityConfig))
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("RockAbility requires a RockAbilityConfig.", this);
            return;
        }

        config = abilityConfig as RockAbilityConfig;
        isActive = true;
        enabled = true;
    }

    private void Update()
    {
        if (Time.timeScale == 0f)
            return;

        if (!isActive || !IsRockMovementActive)
        {
            if (phase != SlamPhase.Inactive)
                CancelSlam();

            return;
        }

        if (phase == SlamPhase.Inactive
            && input != null
            && input.GameplayInputEnabled
            && Keyboard.current != null
            && Keyboard.current.sKey.wasPressedThisFrame)
        {
            BeginHop();
        }
    }

    private void FixedUpdate()
    {
        if (!IsRockMovementActive)
        {
            if (phase != SlamPhase.Inactive)
                CancelSlam();

            return;
        }

        if (phase == SlamPhase.Inactive)
            return;

        if (phase == SlamPhase.Hopping)
        {
            if (body.position.y >= hopStartY + HopHeight || body.linearVelocity.y <= 0f)
                BeginSlam();

            return;
        }

        if (HasGroundBelow())
        {
            FinishSlam();
            return;
        }

        body.linearVelocity = new Vector2(body.linearVelocity.x, -SlamSpeed);
    }

    private void BeginHop()
    {
        phase = SlamPhase.Hopping;
        hopStartY = body.position.y;
        float gravity = Mathf.Abs(Physics2D.gravity.y * body.gravityScale);
        float hopVelocity = Mathf.Sqrt(2f * gravity * HopHeight);
        body.linearVelocity = new Vector2(body.linearVelocity.x, hopVelocity);
    }

    private void BeginSlam()
    {
        phase = SlamPhase.Slamming;
        body.linearVelocity = new Vector2(body.linearVelocity.x, -SlamSpeed);
    }

    private void OnCollisionEnter2D(Collision2D collision)
    {
        TryBreakBreakable(collision.collider, GetContactPoint(collision));
    }

    private void OnCollisionStay2D(Collision2D collision)
    {
        TryBreakBreakable(collision.collider, GetContactPoint(collision));
    }

    private void OnTriggerEnter2D(Collider2D other)
    {
        TryBreakBreakable(other, other.ClosestPoint(body.worldCenterOfMass));
    }

    private void OnTriggerStay2D(Collider2D other)
    {
        TryBreakBreakable(other, other.ClosestPoint(body.worldCenterOfMass));
    }

    private Vector2 GetContactPoint(Collision2D collision)
    {
        return collision.contactCount > 0
            ? collision.GetContact(0).point
            : collision.collider.ClosestPoint(body.worldCenterOfMass);
    }

    private void TryBreakBreakable(Collider2D contact, Vector2 contactPoint)
    {
        if (phase != SlamPhase.Slamming
            || contact == null
            || contact.transform.root == transform.root
            || !contact.CompareTag(BreakableTag))
            return;

        Tilemap tilemap = contact.GetComponent<Tilemap>();
        if (tilemap != null)
        {
            RemoveContactedTile(tilemap, contactPoint);
            return;
        }

        contact.gameObject.SetActive(false);
        Destroy(contact.gameObject);
    }

    private void RemoveContactedTile(Tilemap tilemap, Vector2 contactPoint)
    {
        Vector2 towardTile = (contactPoint - body.worldCenterOfMass).normalized;
        Vector3 cellWidth = tilemap.CellToWorld(Vector3Int.right) - tilemap.CellToWorld(Vector3Int.zero);
        Vector3 cellHeight = tilemap.CellToWorld(Vector3Int.up) - tilemap.CellToWorld(Vector3Int.zero);
        float probeDistance = Mathf.Min(cellWidth.magnitude, cellHeight.magnitude) * 0.05f;
        Vector3Int cell = tilemap.WorldToCell(contactPoint + towardTile * probeDistance);

        if (tilemap.HasTile(cell))
            tilemap.SetTile(cell, null);
    }

    private bool HasGroundBelow()
    {
        if (bodyCollider == null)
            return false;

        int hitCount = bodyCollider.Cast(Vector2.down, collisionFilter, groundHits, GroundProbeDistance);
        for (int i = 0; i < hitCount; i++)
        {
            RaycastHit2D hit = groundHits[i];
            if (hit.collider == null
                || hit.transform.root == transform.root
                || hit.normal.y < 0.5f
                || IsBreakable(hit.transform))
            {
                continue;
            }

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static bool IsBreakable(Transform target)
    {
        while (target != null)
        {
            if (target.CompareTag(BreakableTag))
                return true;
            target = target.parent;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void FinishSlam()
    {
        phase = SlamPhase.Inactive;
        body.linearVelocity = new Vector2(body.linearVelocity.x, Mathf.Max(0f, body.linearVelocity.y));
    }

    private void CancelSlam()
    {
        phase = SlamPhase.Inactive;
    }

    private void OnDisable()
    {
        phase = SlamPhase.Inactive;
    }
}

namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine
{
    public abstract class BlobGroundedState : BlobState
    {
        protected BlobGroundedState(BlobController blob) : base(blob)
        {
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Evaluates high-priority transitions shared by all grounded substates.
        /// The check order defines transition priority: leaving the ground before
        /// jumping. A null result means no shared transition was requested, so the
        /// concrete state should continue evaluating its own Tick logic.
        /// </summary>
        protected BlobState TickGrounded()
        {
            if (!Blob.Sensors.IsGrounded)
                return Blob.FallState;

            if (Blob.Input.JumpPressed)
                return Blob.JumpState;

            return null;
        }
    }
}

namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine
{
    public abstract class BlobState
    {
        protected BlobController Blob { get; }

        protected BlobState(BlobController blob)
        {
            Blob = blob;
        }

        public virtual void Enter()
        {
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Runs once per rendered frame. Its primary responsibilities are reading
        /// frame-based input, updating state timing or phases, and returning a
        /// requested transition. Returning null keeps the current state. A Tick
        /// may also cache one-shot physics requests for the next FixedTick.
        /// </summary>
        public abstract BlobState Tick(float deltaTime);

        /// <summary>
        /// Runs on Unity's fixed physics timestep. Its primary responsibility is
        /// applying Rigidbody2D velocity, gravity, and jump-cut changes, including
        /// consuming physics requests previously cached by Tick.
        /// </summary>
        public virtual void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)
        {
        }

        public virtual void Exit()
        {
        }
    }
}



================================================
FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/StateMachine/BlobStateMachine.cs
================================================
namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine
{
    public sealed class BlobStateMachine
    {
        public BlobState CurrentState { get; private set; }
        public bool IsRunning { get; private set; } = true;

        public void Initialize(BlobState startingState)
        {
            if (startingState == null)
                return;

            CurrentState = startingState;
            CurrentState.Enter();
        }

        public void Tick(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (!IsRunning || CurrentState == null)
                return;

            BlobState nextState = CurrentState.Tick(deltaTime);
            if (nextState == null || nextState == CurrentState)
                return;

            ChangeState(nextState);
        }

        public void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)
        {
            if (!IsRunning || CurrentState == null)
                return;

            CurrentState.FixedTick(fixedDeltaTime);
        }

        public void ForceChangeState(BlobState nextState)
        {
            if (!IsRunning || nextState == null || nextState == CurrentState)
                return;

            ChangeState(nextState);
        }

        public void Stop()
        {
            IsRunning = false;
        }

        private void ChangeState(BlobState nextState)
        {
            CurrentState.Exit();
            CurrentState = nextState;
            CurrentState.Enter();
        }
    }
}



================================================
FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/StateMachine/States/BlobFallState.cs

namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine.States
{
    public sealed class BlobFallState : BlobState
    {
        public BlobFallState(BlobController blob) : base(blob)
        {
        }

        public override void Enter()
        {
            Blob.SetGravity(Blob.FallGravityScale);
        }

        public override BlobState Tick(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (Blob.Input.SprintPressed && Blob.TryUseDash())
                return Blob.SprintState;

            if (!Blob.Sensors.IsGrounded || Blob.Body.linearVelocity.y > 0.05f)
                return null;

            return Blob.HasMoveInput ? Blob.MoveState : Blob.IdleState;
        }

        public override void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)
        {
            if (!Blob.IsGrappling && !Blob.PreserveGrappleMomentum)
                Blob.ApplyAirMovement();

            Blob.ClampFallSpeed();
        }
    }
}

namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine.States
{
    public sealed class BlobIdleState : BlobGroundedState
    {
        public BlobIdleState(BlobController blob) : base(blob)
        {
        }

        public override BlobState Tick(float deltaTime)
        {
            BlobState transition = TickGrounded();
            if (transition != null)
                return transition;

            if (Blob.Input.SprintPressed && Blob.TryUseDash())
                return Blob.SprintState;

            if (Blob.HasMoveInput)
                return Blob.MoveState;

            return null;
        }

        public override void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)
        {

                Blob.StopHorizontalMovement();
        }
    }

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/StateMachine/States/BlobJumpState.cs
================================================
namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine.States
{
    public sealed class BlobJumpState : BlobState
    {
        private bool jumpCutApplied;
        private bool jumpCutRequested;

        public BlobJumpState(BlobController blob) : base(blob)
        {
        }

        public override void Enter()
        {
            Blob.RestoreDashAvailability();
            jumpCutApplied = false;
            jumpCutRequested = false;
            Blob.SetGravity(Blob.RiseGravityScale);
            Blob.SetVerticalVelocity(Blob.GetCurrentJumpSpeed());
        }

        public override BlobState Tick(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (Blob.Input.SprintPressed && Blob.TryUseDash())
                return Blob.SprintState;

            if (!jumpCutApplied && Blob.Input.JumpReleased && Blob.Body.linearVelocity.y > 0f)
                jumpCutRequested = true;

            return Blob.Body.linearVelocity.y <= 0f ? Blob.FallState : null;
        }

        public override void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)
        {
            if (jumpCutRequested)
            {
                if (!jumpCutApplied && Blob.Body.linearVelocity.y > 0f)
                {
                    Blob.CutJump();
                    Blob.SetGravity(Blob.ReleasedRiseGravityScale);
                    jumpCutApplied = true;
                }

                // Consume the request even if ascent ended before this physics step.
                jumpCutRequested = false;
            }

            if (!Blob.IsGrappling && !Blob.PreserveGrappleMomentum)
                Blob.ApplyAirMovement();
        }
    }
}

namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine.States

    public sealed class BlobMoveState : BlobGroundedState
    {
        public BlobMoveState(BlobController blob) : base(blob)
        {
        }

        public override BlobState Tick(float deltaTime)
        {
            BlobState transition = TickGrounded();
            if (transition != null)
                return transition;

            if (Blob.Input.SprintPressed && Blob.TryUseDash())
                return Blob.SprintState;

                return Blob.IdleState;

        public override void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)

        }
    }

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/StateMachine/States/BlobSprintState.cs
================================================
using UnityEngine;

namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine.States
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A directional burst that can be used on the ground or in the air. Holding
    /// sprint after a grounded burst continues into horizontal sustained sprint.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class BlobSprintState : BlobState
    {
        private enum SprintPhase
        {
            Burst,
            Sustained
        }

        private SprintPhase phase;
        private Vector2 direction;
        private float burstElapsed;

        public bool IsBurstPhase => phase == SprintPhase.Burst;

        public BlobSprintState(BlobController blob) : base(blob)
        {
        }

        public override void Enter()
        {
            Vector2 inputDirection = new(Blob.Input.MoveX, Blob.Input.MoveY);
            direction = inputDirection.sqrMagnitude > 0.01f
                ? inputDirection.normalized
                : Vector2.right * Blob.FacingDirection;

            if (Mathf.Abs(direction.x) > Mathf.Epsilon)
                Blob.SetFacingDirection(direction.x);
            phase = SprintPhase.Burst;
            burstElapsed = 0f;
        }

        public override BlobState Tick(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (phase == SprintPhase.Burst)
            {
                burstElapsed += deltaTime;
                if (burstElapsed < Blob.SprintBurstDuration)
                    return null;

                if (!Blob.Sensors.IsGrounded)
                    return Blob.FallState;

                if (!Blob.Input.SprintHeld)
                    return GetNormalGroundedState();

                phase = SprintPhase.Sustained;
            }

            if (!Blob.Sensors.IsGrounded)
                return Blob.FallState;

            if (Blob.Input.JumpPressed)
                return Blob.JumpState;

            if (!Blob.Input.SprintHeld)
                return GetNormalGroundedState();

            // The burst direction is committed. Direction changes become available
            // only in the sustained phase.
            if (Blob.HasMoveInput)
            {
                direction.x = Mathf.Sign(Blob.Input.MoveX);
                Blob.SetFacingDirection(direction.x);
            }

            return null;
        }

        public override void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)
        {
            if (Blob.IsGrappling)
                return;

            if (phase == SprintPhase.Burst)
            {
                Blob.Body.linearVelocity = direction * Blob.SprintBurstSpeed;
                return;
            }

            Blob.SetHorizontalVelocity(direction.x * Blob.SustainedSprintSpeed);
        }

        private BlobState GetNormalGroundedState()
        {
            return Blob.HasMoveInput ? Blob.MoveState : Blob.IdleState;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/StateMachine/States/BlobTransformState.cs
================================================
namespace BlobGame.Player.StateMachine.States
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Locks gameplay input while a material profile performs TransformOut,
    /// swaps at the invisible midpoint, and finishes with TransformIn.
    /// This state is entered only from Idle and exits only back to Idle.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class BlobTransformState : BlobState
    {
        public BlobTransformState(BlobController blob) : base(blob)
        {
        }

        public override void Enter()
        {
            Blob.Input.SetGameplayInputEnabled(false);
            Blob.StopHorizontalMovement();
            Blob.Animation?.BeginTransformation(Blob.PendingMovementConfig);
        }

        public override BlobState Tick(float deltaTime)
        {
            return Blob.Animation == null || Blob.Animation.IsTransformationComplete
                ? Blob.IdleState
                : null;
        }

        public override void FixedTick(float fixedDeltaTime)
        {
            Blob.StopHorizontalMovement();
        }

        public override void Exit()
        {
            Blob.Animation?.FinishTransformation();
            Blob.Input.SetGameplayInputEnabled(true);
        }
    }
}

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/UI/LevelGoalTrigger.cs
================================================
using BlobGame.Player;
using UnityEngine;

namespace BlobGame.UI
{
    /// <summary>Shows completion once when the player reaches this smiley marker.</summary>
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    [RequireComponent(typeof(BoxCollider2D))]
    public sealed class LevelGoalTrigger : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private UIController uiController;

        private bool consumed;

        private void Reset()
        {
            GetComponent<BoxCollider2D>().isTrigger = true;
        }

        private void OnTriggerEnter2D(Collider2D other)
        {
            if (consumed || uiController == null)
                return;

            // A player collider may be on a child of the Rigidbody2D or controller.
            BlobController player = other.attachedRigidbody != null
                ? other.attachedRigidbody.GetComponentInParent<BlobController>()
                : other.GetComponentInParent<BlobController>();

            if (player == null)
                return;

            // Each marker has its own latch; reloading the scene resets both goals.
            consumed = true;
            uiController.ShowLevelComplete();
        }
    }
}

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/UI/MaterialHUD.cs

using BlobGame.Player;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

namespace BlobGame.UI
{
    /// <summary>Displays the player's active movement profile without polling it each frame.</summary>
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public sealed class MaterialHUD : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private BlobController player;
        [SerializeField] private TMP_Text materialLabel;

        private bool hasStarted;

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            if (player != null)
                player.MovementConfigChanged += RefreshMaterial;

            // The player may have changed material while this HUD was disabled.
            if (hasStarted)
                RefreshCurrentMaterial();
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            // The first read must occur after the player's Awake initialization.
            hasStarted = true;
            RefreshCurrentMaterial();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            if (player != null)
                player.MovementConfigChanged -= RefreshMaterial;
        }

        private void RefreshCurrentMaterial()
        {
            RefreshMaterial(player != null ? player.CurrentMovementConfig : null);
        }

        private void RefreshMaterial(BlobMovementConfig config)
        {
            if (materialLabel == null)
                return;

            string displayName = config != null ? config.DisplayName : null;
            materialLabel.text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName)
                ? "Material: —"
                : $"Material: {displayName}";
        }
    }
}

FILE: Assets/Scripts/Blob/UI/UIController.cs
================================================
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace BlobGame.UI
{
    /// <summary>Owns scene-local menus, gameplay pause, and scene navigation.</summary>
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-100)]
    public sealed class UIController : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private GameObject pausePanel;
        [SerializeField] private GameObject controlsPanel;
        [SerializeField] private GameObject mainMenuPanel;
        [SerializeField] private GameObject levelCompletePanel;
        [SerializeField] private string playSceneName = "LevelDesignTest";

        private const string MainMenuScene = "MainMenu";
        private float timeScaleBeforePause;
        private bool sceneChangePending;
        private bool mainMenuWasVisible;
        private bool pauseMenuWasVisible;

        public bool IsPaused { get; private set; }
        public bool ControlsAreOpen { get; private set; }
        public bool IsLevelComplete { get; private set; }

        private void Awake()
        {
            if (pausePanel != null)
                pausePanel.SetActive(false);
            if (controlsPanel != null)
                controlsPanel.SetActive(false);
            if (levelCompletePanel != null)
                levelCompletePanel.SetActive(false);
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (sceneChangePending || Keyboard.current?.escapeKey.wasPressedThisFrame != true)
                return;

            // Closing help returns to its parent menu without resuming gameplay.
            if (ControlsAreOpen)
                HideControls();
            else if (IsLevelComplete)
                ContinueLevel();
            else
                TogglePause();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            // Disabling or unloading this UI must not leave the next scene frozen.
            CloseOverlays();
        }

        public void TogglePause()
        {
            if (sceneChangePending || IsLevelComplete)
                return;

            if (ControlsAreOpen)
            {
                HideControls();
                return;
            }

            if (pausePanel != null)
                SetPaused(!IsPaused);
        }

        public void ShowControls()
        {
            if (controlsPanel == null || sceneChangePending || ControlsAreOpen || IsLevelComplete)
                return;

            mainMenuWasVisible = mainMenuPanel != null && mainMenuPanel.activeSelf;
            pauseMenuWasVisible = pausePanel != null && pausePanel.activeSelf;
            ControlsAreOpen = true;

            if (mainMenuPanel != null)
                mainMenuPanel.SetActive(false);
            if (pausePanel != null)
                pausePanel.SetActive(false);
            controlsPanel.SetActive(true);
        }

        public void HideControls()
        {
            if (!ControlsAreOpen)
                return;

            ControlsAreOpen = false;
            if (controlsPanel != null)
                controlsPanel.SetActive(false);
            if (mainMenuPanel != null)
                mainMenuPanel.SetActive(mainMenuWasVisible);
            if (pausePanel != null)
                pausePanel.SetActive(pauseMenuWasVisible && IsPaused && !IsLevelComplete);
        }

        /// <summary>Shows a goal popup once the level's goal trigger reports success.</summary>
        public void ShowLevelComplete()
        {
            if (levelCompletePanel == null || sceneChangePending || IsLevelComplete)
                return;

            HideControls();
            IsLevelComplete = true;
            SetPaused(true);
            levelCompletePanel.SetActive(true);
        }

        public void ContinueLevel()
        {
            if (!IsLevelComplete || sceneChangePending)
                return;

            IsLevelComplete = false;
            if (levelCompletePanel != null)
                levelCompletePanel.SetActive(false);
            SetPaused(false);
        }

        public void ReloadLevel()
        {
            Scene scene = SceneManager.GetActiveScene();
            int buildIndex = scene.buildIndex;
            bool canReloadFromBuild = buildIndex >= 0
                && SceneUtility.GetScenePathByBuildIndex(buildIndex) == scene.path
                && Application.CanStreamedLevelBeLoaded(buildIndex);

#if UNITY_EDITOR
            // The sandbox level is deliberately excluded from the build scene list.
            if (!canReloadFromBuild && scene.IsValid() && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(scene.path))
            {
                if (TryBeginSceneChange(true, scene.path))
                {
                    UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.LoadSceneAsyncInPlayMode(
                        scene.path, new LoadSceneParameters(LoadSceneMode.Single));
                }
                return;
            }
#endif

            if (TryBeginSceneChange(canReloadFromBuild, scene.name))
                SceneManager.LoadScene(buildIndex);
        }

        public void BackToMenu() => LoadScene(MainMenuScene);

        // Keep this method name so existing persistent button listeners remain valid.
        public void PlayFirstLevel() => LoadScene(playSceneName);

        public void ExitGame()
        {
            if (!sceneChangePending)
                Application.Quit();
        }

        private void SetPaused(bool paused)
        {
            if (IsPaused != paused)
            {
                IsPaused = paused;
                if (paused)
                {
                    timeScaleBeforePause = Time.timeScale;
                    Time.timeScale = 0f;
                }
                else
                {
                    Time.timeScale = timeScaleBeforePause;
                }
            }

            if (pausePanel != null)
                pausePanel.SetActive(paused && !ControlsAreOpen && !IsLevelComplete);
        }

        private void CloseOverlays()
        {
            HideControls();
            IsLevelComplete = false;
            if (levelCompletePanel != null)
                levelCompletePanel.SetActive(false);
            SetPaused(false);
        }

        private void LoadScene(string sceneName)
        {
            if (TryBeginSceneChange(Application.CanStreamedLevelBeLoaded(sceneName), sceneName))
                SceneManager.LoadScene(sceneName);
        }

        private bool TryBeginSceneChange(bool canLoad, string sceneName)
        {
            if (sceneChangePending)
                return false;

            if (!canLoad)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Scene '{sceneName}' is not available to load.", this);
                return false;
            }

            sceneChangePending = true;
            CloseOverlays();
            return true;
        }
    }
}

FILE: Assets/TextMesh Pro/Shaders/SDFFunctions.hlsl

float2 UnpackUV(float uv)
{
	float2 output;
	output.x = floor(uv / 4096.0);
	output.y = uv - 4096.0 * output.x;

	return output * 0.001953125;
}

float4 BlendARGB(float4 overlying, float4 underlying)
{
	overlying.rgb *= overlying.a;
	underlying.rgb *= underlying.a;
	float3 blended = overlying.rgb + ((1 - overlying.a) * underlying.rgb);
	float alpha = underlying.a + (1 - underlying.a) * overlying.a;
	return float4(blended / alpha, alpha);
}

float3 GetSpecular(float3 n, float3 l)
{
	float spec = pow(max(0.0, dot(n, l)), _Reflectivity);
	return _SpecularColor.rgb * spec * _SpecularPower;
}

void GetSurfaceNormal_float(texture2D atlas, float textureWidth, float textureHeight, float2 uv, bool isFront, out float3 nornmal)
{
	float3 delta = float3(1.0 / textureWidth, 1.0 / textureHeight, 0.0);

	// Read "height field"
	float4 h = float4(
		SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(atlas, SamplerState_Linear_Clamp, uv - delta.xz).a,
		SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(atlas, SamplerState_Linear_Clamp, uv + delta.xz).a,
		SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(atlas, SamplerState_Linear_Clamp, uv - delta.zy).a,
		SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D(atlas, SamplerState_Linear_Clamp, uv + delta.zy).a);

	bool raisedBevel = _BevelType;

	h += _BevelOffset;

	float bevelWidth = max(.01, _BevelWidth);

	// Track outline
	h -= .5;
	h /= bevelWidth;
	h = saturate(h + .5);

	if (raisedBevel) h = 1 - abs(h * 2.0 - 1.0);
	h = lerp(h, sin(h * 3.141592 / 2.0), float4(_BevelRoundness, _BevelRoundness, _BevelRoundness, _BevelRoundness));
	h = min(h, 1.0 - float4(_BevelClamp, _BevelClamp, _BevelClamp, _BevelClamp));
	h *= _BevelAmount * bevelWidth * _GradientScale * -2.0;

	float3 va = normalize(float3(-1.0, 0.0, h.y - h.x));
	float3 vb = normalize(float3(0.0, 1.0, h.w - h.z));

	float3 f = float3(1, 1, 1);
	if (isFront) f = float3(1, 1, -1);
	nornmal = cross(va, vb) * f;
}

void EvaluateLight_float(float4 faceColor, float3 n, out float4 color)
{
	n.z = abs(n.z);
	float3 light = normalize(float3(sin(_LightAngle), cos(_LightAngle), 1.0));

	float3 col = max(faceColor.rgb, 0) + GetSpecular(n, light)* faceColor.a;
	//faceColor.rgb += col * faceColor.a;
	col *= 1 - (dot(n, light) * _Diffuse);
	col *= lerp(_Ambient, 1, n.z * n.z);

	//fixed4 reflcol = texCUBE(_Cube, reflect(input.viewDir, -n));
	//faceColor.rgb += reflcol.rgb * lerp(_ReflectFaceColor.rgb, _ReflectOutlineColor.rgb, saturate(sd + outline * 0.5)) * faceColor.a;

	color = float4(col, faceColor.a);
}

// Add custom function to handle time in HDRP


//
void GenerateUV_float(float2 inUV, float4 transform, float2 animSpeed, out float2 outUV)
{
	outUV = inUV * transform.xy + transform.zw + (animSpeed * _Time.y);
}

void ComputeUVOffset_float(float texWidth, float texHeight, float2 offset, float SDR, out float2 uvOffset)
{
	uvOffset = float2(-offset.x * SDR / texWidth, -offset.y * SDR / texHeight);
}

void ScreenSpaceRatio2_float(float4x4 projection, float4 position, float2 objectScale, float screenWidth, float screenHeight, float fontScale, out float SSR)
{
	float2 pixelSize = position.w;
	pixelSize /= (objectScale * mul((float2x2)projection, float2(screenWidth, screenHeight)));
	SSR = rsqrt(dot(pixelSize, pixelSize)*2) * fontScale;
}

// UV			: Texture coordinate of the source distance field texture
// TextureSize	: Size of the source distance field texture
// Filter		: Enable perspective filter (soften)
void ScreenSpaceRatio_float(float2 UV, float TextureSize, bool Filter, out float SSR)
{
	if(Filter)
	{
		float2 a = float2(ddx(UV.x), ddy(UV.x));
		float2 b = float2(ddx(UV.y), ddy(UV.y));
		float s = lerp(dot(a,a), dot(b,b), 0.5);
		SSR = rsqrt(s) / TextureSize;
	}
	else
	{
		float s = rsqrt(abs(ddx(UV.x) * ddy(UV.y) - ddy(UV.x) * ddx(UV.y)));
		SSR = s / TextureSize;
	}
}

// SSR : Screen Space Ratio
// SD  : Signed Distance (encoded : Distance / SDR + .5)
// SDR : Signed Distance Ratio
//
// IsoPerimeter : Dilate / Contract the shape
void ComputeSDF_float(float SSR, float SD, float SDR, float isoPerimeter, float softness, out float outAlpha)
{
	softness *= SSR * SDR;
	float d = (SD - 0.5) * SDR;																				// Signed distance to edge, in Texture space
	outAlpha = saturate((d * 2.0 * SSR + 0.5 + isoPerimeter * SDR * SSR + softness * 0.5) / (1.0 + softness));	// Screen pixel coverage (alpha)
}

void ComputeSDF2_float(float SSR, float SD, float SDR, float2 isoPerimeter, float2 softness, out float2 outAlpha)
{
	softness *= SSR * SDR;
	float d = (SD - 0.5f) * SDR;
	outAlpha = saturate((d * 2.0f * SSR + 0.5f + isoPerimeter * SDR * SSR + softness * 0.5) / (1.0 + softness));
}

void ComputeSDF4_float(float SSR, float SD, float SDR, float4 isoPerimeter, float4 softness, out float4 outAlpha)
{
	softness *= SSR * SDR;
	float d = (SD - 0.5f) * SDR;
	outAlpha = saturate((d * 2.0f * SSR + 0.5f + isoPerimeter * SDR * SSR + softness * 0.5) / (1.0 + softness));
}

void ComputeSDF44_float(float SSR, float4 SD, float SDR, float4 isoPerimeter, float4 softness, bool outline, out float4 outAlpha)
{
	softness *= SSR * SDR;
	float4 d = (SD - 0.5f) * SDR;
	if(outline) d.w = max(max(d.x, d.y), d.z);
	outAlpha = saturate((d * 2.0f * SSR + 0.5f + isoPerimeter * SDR * SSR + softness * 0.5) / (1.0 + softness));
}

void Composite_float(float4 overlying, float4 underlying, out float4 outColor)
{
	outColor = BlendARGB(overlying, underlying);
}

// Face only
void Layer1_float(float alpha, float4 color0, out float4 outColor)
{
	color0.a *= alpha;
	outColor = color0;
}

// Face + 1 Outline
void Layer2_float(float2 alpha, float4 color0, float4 color1, out float4 outColor)
{
	color1.a *= alpha.y;
	color0.rgb *= color0.a; color1.rgb *= color1.a;
	outColor = lerp(color1, color0, alpha.x);
	outColor.rgb /= outColor.a;
}

// Face + 3 Outline
void Layer4_float(float4 alpha, float4 color0, float4 color1, float4 color2, float4 color3, out float4 outColor)
{
	color3.a *= alpha.w;
	color0.rgb *= color0.a; color1.rgb *= color1.a; color2.rgb *= color2.a; color3.rgb *= color3.a;
	outColor = lerp(lerp(lerp(color3, color2, alpha.z), color1, alpha.y), color0, alpha.x);
	outColor.rgb /= outColor.a;
}

FILE: Assets/TextMesh Pro/Shaders/TMP_Bitmap-Custom-Atlas.shader

Shader "TextMeshPro/Bitmap Custom Atlas" {

Properties {
	_MainTex		    ("Font Atlas", 2D) = "white" {}
	_FaceTex		    ("Font Texture", 2D) = "white" {}
	_FaceColor	        ("Text Color", Color) = (1,1,1,1)

	_VertexOffsetX	    ("Vertex OffsetX", float) = 0
	_VertexOffsetY	    ("Vertex OffsetY", float) = 0
	_MaskSoftnessX	    ("Mask SoftnessX", float) = 0
	_MaskSoftnessY	    ("Mask SoftnessY", float) = 0

	_ClipRect		    ("Clip Rect", vector) = (-32767, -32767, 32767, 32767)
	_Padding		    ("Padding", float) = 0

	_StencilComp        ("Stencil Comparison", Float) = 8
	_Stencil            ("Stencil ID", Float) = 0
	_StencilOp          ("Stencil Operation", Float) = 0
	_StencilWriteMask   ("Stencil Write Mask", Float) = 255
	_StencilReadMask    ("Stencil Read Mask", Float) = 255

	_CullMode           ("Cull Mode", Float) = 0
	_ColorMask          ("Color Mask", Float) = 15
}

SubShader{

	Tags { "Queue" = "Transparent" "IgnoreProjector" = "True" "RenderType" = "Transparent" }

	Stencil
	{
		Ref[_Stencil]
		Comp[_StencilComp]
		Pass[_StencilOp]
		ReadMask[_StencilReadMask]
		WriteMask[_StencilWriteMask]
	}


	Lighting Off
	Cull [_CullMode]
	ZTest [unity_GUIZTestMode]
	ZWrite Off
	Fog { Mode Off }
	Blend SrcAlpha OneMinusSrcAlpha
	ColorMask[_ColorMask]

	Pass {
		CGPROGRAM
		#pragma vertex vert
		#pragma fragment frag

		#pragma multi_compile __ UNITY_UI_CLIP_RECT
		#pragma multi_compile __ UNITY_UI_ALPHACLIP


		#include "UnityCG.cginc"
		#include "UnityUI.cginc"

		struct appdata_t
		{
			float4 vertex		: POSITION;
			fixed4 color		: COLOR;
			float4 texcoord0	: TEXCOORD0;
			float2 texcoord1	: TEXCOORD1;
		};

		struct v2f
		{
			float4	vertex		: SV_POSITION;
			fixed4	color		: COLOR;
			float2	texcoord0	: TEXCOORD0;
			float2	texcoord1	: TEXCOORD1;
			float4	mask		: TEXCOORD2;
		};

		uniform	sampler2D 	_MainTex;
		uniform	sampler2D 	_FaceTex;
		uniform float4		_FaceTex_ST;
		uniform	fixed4		_FaceColor;

		uniform float		_VertexOffsetX;
		uniform float		_VertexOffsetY;
		uniform float4		_ClipRect;
		uniform float		_MaskSoftnessX;
		uniform float		_MaskSoftnessY;
		uniform float		_UIMaskSoftnessX;
        uniform float		_UIMaskSoftnessY;
        uniform int _UIVertexColorAlwaysGammaSpace;

		v2f vert (appdata_t v)
		{
			float4 vert = v.vertex;
			vert.x += _VertexOffsetX;
			vert.y += _VertexOffsetY;

			vert.xy += (vert.w * 0.5) / _ScreenParams.xy;

			float4 vPosition = UnityPixelSnap(UnityObjectToClipPos(vert));

            if (_UIVertexColorAlwaysGammaSpace && !IsGammaSpace())
            {
                v.color.rgb = UIGammaToLinear(v.color.rgb);
            }
			fixed4 faceColor = v.color;
			faceColor *= _FaceColor;

			v2f OUT;
			OUT.vertex = vPosition;
			OUT.color = faceColor;
			OUT.texcoord0 = v.texcoord0;
			OUT.texcoord1 = TRANSFORM_TEX(v.texcoord1, _FaceTex);
			float2 pixelSize = vPosition.w;
			pixelSize /= abs(float2(_ScreenParams.x * UNITY_MATRIX_P[0][0], _ScreenParams.y * UNITY_MATRIX_P[1][1]));

			// Clamp _ClipRect to 16bit.
			const float4 clampedRect = clamp(_ClipRect, -2e10, 2e10);
			const half2 maskSoftness = half2(max(_UIMaskSoftnessX, _MaskSoftnessX), max(_UIMaskSoftnessY, _MaskSoftnessY));
			OUT.mask = float4(vert.xy * 2 - clampedRect.xy - clampedRect.zw, 0.25 / (0.25 * maskSoftness + pixelSize.xy));

			return OUT;
		}

		fixed4 frag (v2f IN) : SV_Target
		{
			fixed4 color = tex2D(_MainTex, IN.texcoord0) * tex2D(_FaceTex, IN.texcoord1) * IN.color;

			// Alternative implementation to UnityGet2DClipping with support for softness.
			#if UNITY_UI_CLIP_RECT
				half2 m = saturate((_ClipRect.zw - _ClipRect.xy - abs(IN.mask.xy)) * IN.mask.zw);
				color *= m.x * m.y;
			#endif

			#if UNITY_UI_ALPHACLIP
				clip(color.a - 0.001);
			#endif

			return color;
		}
		ENDCG
	}
}

	CustomEditor "TMPro.EditorUtilities.TMP_BitmapShaderGUI"
}

			vert.x += _VertexOffsetX;
			vert.y += _VertexOffsetY;

			vert.xy += (vert.w * 0.5) / _ScreenParams.xy;
            if (_UIVertexColorAlwaysGammaSpace && !IsGammaSpace())
            {
                v.color.rgb = UIGammaToLinear(v.color.rgb);
            }
            OUT.vertex = UnityPixelSnap(UnityObjectToClipPos(vert));
			OUT.color = v.color;
			OUT.color *= _Color;
			OUT.color.rgb *= _DiffusePower;
			OUT.texcoord0 = v.texcoord0;

			float2 pixelSize = OUT.vertex.w;
			//pixelSize /= abs(float2(_ScreenParams.x * UNITY_MATRIX_P[0][0], _ScreenParams.y * UNITY_MATRIX_P[1][1]));

			// Clamp _ClipRect to 16bit.
			const float4 clampedRect = clamp(_ClipRect, -2e10, 2e10);
			const half2 maskSoftness = half2(max(_UIMaskSoftnessX, _MaskSoftnessX), max(_UIMaskSoftnessY, _MaskSoftnessY));
			OUT.mask = float4(vert.xy * 2 - clampedRect.xy - clampedRect.zw, 0.25 / (0.25 * maskSoftness + pixelSize.xy));

			return OUT;
		}

		fixed4 frag (v2f IN) : COLOR
		{
			fixed4 color = fixed4(IN.color.rgb, IN.color.a * tex2D(_MainTex, IN.texcoord0).a);

			// Alternative implementation to UnityGet2DClipping with support for softness.
			#if UNITY_UI_CLIP_RECT
				half2 m = saturate((_ClipRect.zw - _ClipRect.xy - abs(IN.mask.xy)) * IN.mask.zw);
				color *= m.x * m.y;
			#endif

			#if UNITY_UI_ALPHACLIP
				clip(color.a - 0.001);
			#endif

			return color;
		}
		ENDCG
	}
}

SubShader {
	Tags { "Queue"="Transparent" "IgnoreProjector"="True" "RenderType"="Transparent" }
	Lighting Off Cull Off ZTest Always ZWrite Off Fog { Mode Off }
	Blend SrcAlpha OneMinusSrcAlpha
	BindChannels {
		Bind "Color", color
		Bind "Vertex", vertex
		Bind "TexCoord", texcoord0
	}
	Pass {
		SetTexture [_MainTex] {
			constantColor [_Color] combine constant * primary, constant * texture
		}
	}
}

Shader "TextMeshPro/Bitmap" {

Properties {

	_MaskSoftnessY	    ("Mask SoftnessY", float) = 0

	_ClipRect           ("Clip Rect", vector) = (-32767, -32767, 32767, 32767)

	_StencilComp        ("Stencil Comparison", Float) = 8
	_Stencil            ("Stencil ID", Float) = 0
	_StencilOp          ("Stencil Operation", Float) = 0
	_StencilWriteMask   ("Stencil Write Mask", Float) = 255
	_StencilReadMask    ("Stencil Read Mask", Float) = 255

	_CullMode           ("Cull Mode", Float) = 0
	_ColorMask          ("Color Mask", Float) = 15

SubShader{

	Tags { "Queue" = "Transparent" "IgnoreProjector" = "True" "RenderType" = "Transparent" }

	Stencil
	{
		Ref[_Stencil]
		Comp[_StencilComp]
		Pass[_StencilOp]
		ReadMask[_StencilReadMask]
		WriteMask[_StencilWriteMask]
	}


	Lighting Off
	Cull [_CullMode]
	ZTest [unity_GUIZTestMode]
	ZWrite Off
	Fog { Mode Off }
	Blend SrcAlpha OneMinusSrcAlpha
	ColorMask[_ColorMask]

	Pass {
		CGPROGRAM
		#pragma vertex vert
		#pragma fragment frag

		#pragma multi_compile __ UNITY_UI_CLIP_RECT
		#pragma multi_compile __ UNITY_UI_ALPHACLIP


		#include "UnityCG.cginc"
		#include "UnityUI.cginc"

		struct appdata_t
		{
			float4 vertex		: POSITION;
			fixed4 color		: COLOR;
			float4 texcoord0	: TEXCOORD0;
			float2 texcoord1	: TEXCOORD1;
		};

		struct v2f
		{
			float4	vertex		: SV_POSITION;
			fixed4	color		: COLOR;
			float2	texcoord0	: TEXCOORD0;
			float2	texcoord1	: TEXCOORD1;
			float4	mask		: TEXCOORD2;
		};

		uniform	sampler2D 	_MainTex;
		uniform	sampler2D 	_FaceTex;
		uniform float4		_FaceTex_ST;
		uniform	fixed4		_FaceColor;

		uniform float		_VertexOffsetX;
		uniform float		_VertexOffsetY;
		uniform float4		_ClipRect;
		uniform float		_MaskSoftnessX;
		uniform float		_MaskSoftnessY;
		uniform float		_UIMaskSoftnessX;
        uniform float		_UIMaskSoftnessY;
        uniform int _UIVertexColorAlwaysGammaSpace;

		v2f vert (appdata_t v)
		{
			float4 vert = v.vertex;
			vert.x += _VertexOffsetX;
			vert.y += _VertexOffsetY;

			vert.xy += (vert.w * 0.5) / _ScreenParams.xy;

			float4 vPosition = UnityPixelSnap(UnityObjectToClipPos(vert));

            if (_UIVertexColorAlwaysGammaSpace && !IsGammaSpace())
            {
                v.color.rgb = UIGammaToLinear(v.color.rgb);
            }
			fixed4 faceColor = v.color;
			faceColor *= _FaceColor;

			v2f OUT;
			OUT.vertex = vPosition;
			OUT.color = faceColor;
			OUT.texcoord0 = v.texcoord0;
			OUT.texcoord1 = TRANSFORM_TEX(v.texcoord1, _FaceTex);
			float2 pixelSize = vPosition.w;
			pixelSize /= abs(float2(_ScreenParams.x * UNITY_MATRIX_P[0][0], _ScreenParams.y * UNITY_MATRIX_P[1][1]));

			// Clamp _ClipRect to 16bit.
			const float4 clampedRect = clamp(_ClipRect, -2e10, 2e10);
			const half2 maskSoftness = half2(max(_UIMaskSoftnessX, _MaskSoftnessX), max(_UIMaskSoftnessY, _MaskSoftnessY));
			OUT.mask = float4(vert.xy * 2 - clampedRect.xy - clampedRect.zw, 0.25 / (0.25 * maskSoftness + pixelSize.xy));

			return OUT;
		}

		fixed4 frag (v2f IN) : SV_Target
		{
			fixed4 color = tex2D(_MainTex, IN.texcoord0);
			color = fixed4 (tex2D(_FaceTex, IN.texcoord1).rgb * IN.color.rgb, IN.color.a * color.a);

			// Alternative implementation to UnityGet2DClipping with support for softness.
			#if UNITY_UI_CLIP_RECT
				half2 m = saturate((_ClipRect.zw - _ClipRect.xy - abs(IN.mask.xy)) * IN.mask.zw);
				color *= m.x * m.y;
			#endif

			#if UNITY_UI_ALPHACLIP
				clip(color.a - 0.001);
			#endif

			return color;
		}
		ENDCG
	}
}
